title: ngx-json-render MCP App builder
description: Builds an MCP App view into one view.html and bundles its server into server.mjs.

buildTarget.description: The view's @angular/build:application target, such as "my-app:build:production" or ":build:production" for this project.

outputPath.description: Directory for view.html and server.mjs, relative to the workspace root.

server.description: The server's entry file, bundled into server.mjs. Leave it out to build the view only.

tsConfig.description: The tsconfig esbuild reads for the server (paths, decorators). By default, the nearest one to each file.

externalPackages.description: Leave node_modules packages out of server.mjs, to be installed next to it. By default the server is one self-contained file.
